Here is what the source-evaluation found for **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)** — 7 sources audited, 3 findings:

---

### Finding 1 — Indexing error in marriage year
**"Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968"**

The spouse, church, day, and month all match the profile perfectly. However:
- **Indexed year:** 9 June **1845**
- **Profile records:** 9 June **1849**

The source belongs on the profile. The year appears to be a transcription error in the index. Since this is a "database with images" collection, the original parish register page is accessible. **Action:** Re-read the original image; if it reads 1849, submit a FamilySearch index correction.

---

### Finding 2 — Source-vs-source conflict on death date (needs conflict-resolution)
Two sources give contradictory death dates, seven years apart:

| Source | Death Date |
|---|---|
| "Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979" (burial register) | **April 1878** (buried 14 Apr 1878) |
| "Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900" | **2 February 1885** |

Both also corroborate birthplace Ireland, ca. 1814. The profile currently carries no death date, so neither value is entered yet. One record may name a different Cornelius Driscoll. Neither source should be detached until both originals are examined. **Action:** Route to conflict-resolution; check the burial register image (database with images) and locate the original civil registration certificate (index-only on FamilySearch).

---

### Finding 3 — Residence place discrepancy in 1851 Census
**"Census of Canada East, 1851"**

Birthplace Ireland is consistent with the profile. However:
- **Indexed residence:** Melbourne, Canada East
- **Profile records:** Sherbrooke, Canada East

Melbourne and Sherbrooke are distinct Quebec townships. This could be an indexing error or a profile entry mistake. The collection is index-only on FamilySearch. **Action:** Consult the original 1851 Census return (e.g., Library and Archives Canada) to confirm the enumerated district, then correct whichever record is wrong.

---

### No issues found
- **"Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1655–1915"** — Christening 12 March 1814, Skibbereen, Cork — refines the birth fact without contradicting it. ✅
- **"Census of Canada, 1861"** — Sherbrooke, Canada East, birth year ~1816 (within normal census-age variance from the 1814 profile year). ✅

### Could not verify
- **Driscoll headstone photograph (uploaded memory)** — contributor-uploaded image with no indexed record; content must be reviewed directly, especially given the death date conflict in Finding 2.

---

**Overall:** The profile is in reasonably good shape (FamilySearch quality score GREEN, no impossible-date warnings), but the death date conflict between the two Quebec death records is the most pressing issue and should be resolved before either death date is entered on the profile.

## Sources on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — Findings, worst first

---

### 1. Minnesota State Census, 1885 — **Misattributed source** (detach)

**ARK:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003

The indexed record names a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, with wife Bergit (born 1856) and child Nils (born 1879), residing in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County, Minnesota**. Every comparable field disagrees with this profile:

- Birth year is 23 years too early (1852 vs. 1875).
- County is Otter Tail, not Polk.
- Wife is Bergit, not Inger.
- Child is Nils, not Sivert.

In 1885, Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) was about **ten years old** — he could not have been a household head with a wife and a six-year-old child. The source already appears on **KD96-WX7** (another Christian Hole, born 1852, died 1919 in Otter Tail County), whose facts match the record exactly.

**Action:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### 2. Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002 — **Indexing error** (correct, keep)

**ARK:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002

The indexed record gives a death year of **1954**; the profile records **1945** — a nine-year discrepancy. The day (10 June), month, place (Erskine, Polk County), birth year (1875), and name all agree, pointing to a single-field transcription error in the index rather than a wrong person.

**Action:** Consult the original Minnesota death certificate to confirm 1945, then submit a FamilySearch index correction. Keep the source attached.

---

### Also checked — no findings

- **United States Census, 1900** (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-001): Birth year in the index (1877) differs from the profile (1875) by two years — ordinary census-informant variance, not an error.
- **Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory):** Cannot be verified through indexed records. If the death-year discrepancy (finding 2) remains uncertain after checking the original certificate, this funeral card is worth examining alongside it.

---

### Checklist notes (not errors, but gaps)

- **Marriage has no tagged sources.**
- **Marriage place is missing a city.**

## Sources Audit — 4 sources reviewed, 2 findings

### Finding 1: "Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002" — Indexing Error

The index records the death year as **1954**, but the profile records it as **10 June 1945**. The day and month, place (Erskine, Polk County, Minnesota), full name, and birth year (1875) all match perfectly — only the death year differs. This is consistent with an indexing error on a handwritten entry.

**This is an index-only collection (no images available).** Next steps:
- Consult the original death certificate through the Minnesota Department of Health or Polk County records to confirm the correct year.

Multiple indexed fields disagree with Christian P. Hole's (born 1875) profile:

| Field | Indexed Value | Profile Value |
|-------|--------------|---------------|
| Birth year | 1852 | 1875 |
| Residence | Aurdal, Otter Tail County | Polk County |
| Wife | Bergit Hole | Inger Hole |
| Child | Nils Hole (born 1879) | — (impossible: father would have been ~4 years old) |

Every indexed field matches **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, born 1852 in Norway, died 1919 in Otter Tail County) exactly.

**Action: Detach this source from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.**

---

### No Finding: 1900 United States Census

The indexed birth year (1877) differs from the profile's 1875 by two years — ordinary census variance. All other indexed fields (name, Fairview Township, Polk County) match. **No action needed.**

This is a contributor upload with no readable record ID. Its contents can't be verified through record reads. ---

- The **marriage has no tagged sources**.

---

Here is the audit of sources on **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**, worst finding first:

---

## Sources Audit — 7 in scope, 3 findings

---

### 1. ⚠️ Death date conflict between two attached sources → *route to conflict-resolution*

- **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979** — indexes death **April 1878** in Sherbrooke (burial on 14 April 1878)
- **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900** — indexes death **2 February 1885** in Sherbrooke

A gap of nearly seven years. Both records otherwise fit the same man (birthplace Ireland, birth year 1814, Sherbrooke). Neither misattribution nor a typo explains a 7-year gap — these two sources are in direct conflict. The headstone photograph (contributor-uploaded, discussed below) may carry a year worth consulting alongside both.

**Next step:** Take both to the **conflict-resolution** workflow. Re-reading the original images of each record should settle which date is correct.

---

### 2. Indexing error — marriage year digit off by one digit

- **Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**

Indexed marriage date: **9 June 1845** · Profile records: **9 June 1849**. Day and month match exactly; only the final digit of the year differs ("5" vs. "9"). Church, place, and both parties' names agree in full. A handwriting misread is the likeliest explanation.

**Next step:** Re-open the original register image (collection includes images). If the page confirms 1849, submit an index correction through FamilySearch. Keep the source attached — it is good evidence with one suspect field.

---

### 3. Indexed residence disagrees with profile

- **Census of Canada East, 1851**

Indexed residence: **Melbourne, Canada East** · Profile records: **Sherbrooke, Canada East**. These are distinct municipalities. Name and birthplace (Ireland) fit; only the enumeration district differs. This is either a miskeyed district in the index or a different Cornelius Driscoll entirely. The collection is index-only (no images on FamilySearch).

**Next step:** Consult the original 1851 census schedule via FamilySearch's correction path or Library and Archives Canada to confirm the household and settle whether the district was misindexed or the record belongs to another man. Keep attached pending that check.

---

### Could not fully audit

- **Driscoll headstone photograph, St. Patrick's Cemetery** — contributor-uploaded image, no indexed record ARK. It is a lead, not auditable evidence; worth consulting alongside the burial register and civil death registration when working through finding 1.

## Sources on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — Audit Results

The audit reviewed 4 sources. Two need action:

---

### 1. 🔧 Indexing Error — Minnesota Death Index, 1908-2002
The index records his death year as **1954**, but the profile records **10 June 1945**. The name, birth year (1875, Norway), day, month, and place (Erskine, Polk County, Minnesota) all match — only the death year is off by nine years. This looks like a transcription error in the index rather than a wrong person.

**Action:** Consult the original death certificate. If it reads 1945, submit an index correction on FamilySearch. Keep the source attached — the record is valid, just one field is wrong.

---

### 2. ❌ Misattributed — Minnesota State Census, 1885
This record names a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, living in **Otter Tail County**, married to **Bergit** Hole (b. 1856) with a son **Nils** (b. 1879). Christian P. Hole was born in **1875**, making him approximately 10 years old in 1885 — far too young to be the head of this household. The county, birth year, wife's name, and household composition are all wrong.

This record is already attached to **KD96-WX7**, whose profile (b. 1852, Otter Tail County, d. 1919) matches the census entry precisely. It belongs there.

**Action:** **Detach this record** from Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)'s profile.

---

### 3. ⚠️ Additional Flag — Impossible-Date in the Tree
A **Residence fact dated 1950** appears in the tree — five years after his recorded death of 10 June 1945. You should identify which record produced that residence fact and determine whether it actually belongs to this person.

---

### 4. ℹ️ Could Not Verify
The uploaded memory item (funeral card/photograph) cannot be checked through a record read. It may be useful as a lead, especially if the death year disagreement above is unresolved.

---

- The marriage has no tagged sources.
- A marriage place is missing a city.

**1. Christian P. Hole, "Minnesota Death Index, 1908-2002" — indexing error**
Link: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002
Citation: "Minnesota Death Index, 1908-2002", database, FamilySearch, entry for Christian P. Hole, died 10 June 1945, Polk County, Minnesota.

The index records his death as 10 June **1954**; the profile records 10 June **1945**. The day, month, place (Erskine, Polk County, Minnesota), name, and birth year (1875, Norway) all match. The disagreement is confined to the death year — nine years off on a single field in an otherwise well-fitting record. That is the profile of a transcription or indexing error rather than a record about a different person.

This collection is index-only — the citation reads "database" with no mention of images, so there is no scan to open within FamilySearch. Consult the original death certificate from which this index derives and confirm the year. If the certificate reads 1945, use FamilySearch's index-correction path to correct the indexed year. Keep the source attached: it is good evidence with one bad field.

---

**2. Christian Hole, "Minnesota State Census, 1885" — misattributed**
Link: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003
Citation: "Minnesota State Census, 1885", database, FamilySearch, entry for Christian Hole, Otter Tail County, Minnesota.

The record names a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, residing in Aurdal, **Otter Tail** County, Minnesota in 1885, with a wife named **Bergit** Hole (born 1856) and a son named **Nils** Hole (born 1879 in Minnesota). Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) was born in 1875 — he would have been approximately ten years old in 1885 and could not be the head of a household whose wife was born in 1856 and whose son was born in 1879. The county also differs: the profile records Polk County while this record places the individual in Otter Tail County. Multiple fields are wrong at once — birth year, county, wife's name, and household composition — not a single transcription slip.

This source is also attached to **KD96-WX7**, a Christian Hole whose profile records a birth of 1852 in Norway, a 1885 residence in Aurdal, Otter Tail, Minnesota, and a death in 1919 in Otter Tail — every one of those values matches what the census record shows. The record belongs to that older man.

Detach this record from Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)'s Sources list. The birth year, county, and household in the census fit KD96-WX7's profile, not the subject's.

---

**Could not check:** SD-HOLE-D, "Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)" — this is a contributor-uploaded document with no indexed record behind it and cannot be verified through a record read. If any finding above disputes a date the funeral card's title or citation mentions, the card is worth consulting alongside the original record as a lead; uploader-supplied titles are often copied from the tree and are not independent evidence.

---

**Impossible-date check on the project tree:**

- Contradiction — An event is dated more than 1 year after this person's latest death-like fact. (Death dated 1945-06-10; Residence dated 1950)

This points to a Residence fact in the tree dated 1950, five years after the recorded death. It is worth identifying which census or other record produced that residence fact and whether it belongs to this person.

---

- The marriage has no tagged sources.

- A marriage place is missing a city.

## Sources Audit — 7 sources reviewed, 2 actionable findings

---

### Informational Note — Baptism Record (SD-DRIS-A)
The Catholic Parish Registers baptism entry gives a christening of **12 March 1814** at **Skibbereen, Co. Cork, Ireland**. This is a refinement of the profile's "Birth: 1814, Ireland" — not a conflict. The researcher may wish to update the profile with this more precise date and place.

**"Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621-1968"**
The index reads the marriage year as **1845**, but the profile records **9 June 1849**. All other fields (spouse Margaret Hayes, St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke) match. The original page image is available; re-read it to confirm 1849 and submit an index correction. Keep the source attached — it is otherwise good evidence.

---

### Finding 2 — Ambiguous: 1851 Census of Canada East
The index shows a residence of **Melbourne, Canada East**, but the profile places Cornelius in **Sherbrooke** (consistent with his 1849 marriage and 1861 census). This could be a misindexed place name or a different Cornelius Driscoll. The collection is index-only on FamilySearch; the original rolls at Library and Archives Canada must be checked (look for Margaret Hayes/Driscoll in the same household). Do not detach until the original has been read.

---

Two attached records flatly contradict each other on when Cornelius died:
- **Quebec Catholic Parish Registers** (burial): death **April 1878**, burial 14 April 1878, St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke.
